integrity: A finite exact-arithmetic checker corroborates the theorem; the infinite classification is proved separately using matrices and CRT. All proof and checks are available in this self-contained package.
scientific_limitations: Specific to moduli 3 times a power of two with exponent at least 3; other OEIS conjectures and arbitrary moduli are not addressed; possibility of unindexed earlier proofs is acknowledged.
title: Complete Fibonacci orbit spectrum modulo \(3\cdot 2^k\)
